WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-105.152624 39.957711, -105.152194 39.957807)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-123.706667 45.3814, -123.706375 45.380943, -123.705142 45.380714, -123.702579 45.379937, -123.702028 45.379572, -123.701898 45.379343, -123.701801 45.378886, -123.701346 45.37836, -123.701314 45.377994, -123.701508 45.37772, -123.702254 45.3774, -123.702579 45.376782, -123.704395 45.376485, -123.705109 45.376965, -123.707282 45.37733, -123.707801 45.377353, -123.708093 45.377262, -123.708126 45.377079, -123.708028 45.376987, -123.708028 45.376576, -123.708288 45.376278, -123.708288 45.376027, -123.708093 45.375844, -123.706859 45.375821, -123.70566 45.375799, -123.705109 45.375593, -123.704622 45.375301, -123.704217 45.374829, -123.703845 45.37451, -123.702515 45.374545, -123.701639 45.374281, -123.700828 45.374144, -123.700666 45.373984, -123.700796 45.373892)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Coal Creek Trail' ELSE 'Fawcett Creek Road' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

```sql
WITH coal_creek_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-105.152624 39.957711, -105.152194 39.957807)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
fawcett_creek_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM roads
  WHERE road_name ILIKE 'Fawcett Creek Road'
  LIMIT 1
),
coal_creek_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Area(ST_Transform(geom, 32613)) AS line_length_m,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF')) AS avg_slope_deg
  FROM public.dem_us
  CROSS JOIN coal_creek_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, geom)
),
fawcett_creek_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Area(ST_Transform(geom, 32613)) AS line_length_m,
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF')) AS avg_slope_deg
  FROM public.dem_us
  CROSS JOIN fawcett_creek_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, geom)
)
SELECT
  'Coal Creek Trail' AS route_name,
  avg_slope_deg
FROM coal_creek_slope
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Fawcett Creek Road' AS route_name,
  avg_slope_deg
FROM fawcett_creek_slope
ORDER BY avg_slope_deg DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
